title: Proactive SLO exposure triage and prioritization pipeline
creator: Jordan Blake
description: Implement a backend pipeline that computes a continuous SLO-exposure score per tenant+route by fusing usage, cost, and latency telemetry. The pipeline will produce prioritized triage events for the Console (and incidenting channels) that reflect both likelihood of customer-facing impact and urgency based on remaining SLO burn/budget. Goals: reduce noisy alerts, surface high-risk regressions earlier, and enable tiered escalation for Dedicated/Private customers.
background: Current anomaly alerts are signal-level (e.g., latency spike, cost spike) and produce many low-value notifications. On-call and customer success teams lack a single ranked list of tenants at risk of missing SLAs. This work builds a middle layer that aggregates multi-signal exposure, applies temporal smoothing and escalation budgeting, and emits prioritized incidents with contextual enrichment for faster triage.
acceptance_criteria: A streaming job writes SLO-exposure events to topic 'telemetry.slo_exposure.v1' with schema documented in Confluence
Console UI receives a ranked feed of top-50 at-risk tenants and displays exposure score and top contributing signals
Reduce noisy level-2/level-3 alerts by >=40% (compare 30d baseline) while maintaining >=95% recall for incidents that actually violated SLAs
Automatic enrichment attaches recent deploy/rollout events and model-version changes to each exposure event
On-call runbook links are created and a canary group of internal teams validates correctness for 2 weeks
high_level_solution: Build a Beam streaming job (Dataflow) that ingests existing usage/cost/latency topics, computes per-tenant per-route exposure using a weighted fusion model, applies an urgency budget window (remaining SLO allowance -> escalation tier), deduplicates correlated signals, and emits prioritized events to a new topic. A companion backfill job will re-run the exposure computation for historical windows to allow evaluation and calibration. Console backend and UI will subscribe to the topic to surface the ranked feed and per-incident details.
technical_decisions: Use Apache Beam on Dataflow for streaming (consistent with other telemetry jobs)
Exposure score = weighted sum of z-scored signals (latency, error-rate, token-rate/cost) with exponential smoothing over 5m and 1h windows
Urgency budget computed from SLA allowance: remaining_error_budget and remaining_latency_budget combined to map to Escalation Tier {info,warn,critical}
Correlated suppression: de-dupe events that share >60% of contributing routes within 10m window and collapse into a single tenant-level incident
Store last-90d exposure history in BigQuery for retrospective analysis and threshold tuning
Emit audit metadata (job_version, model_weights_hash, sample_window) with each event for reproducibility
implementation_tasks: Design and document exposure event schema in Confluence: /docs/console/slo-exposure-schema
Implement Beam pipeline: ingest topics -> compute signals -> fusion -> dedupe -> emit
Add backfill mode to pipeline for historical evaluation
Create BigQuery dataset and dashboard: slo_exposure.metrics and slo_exposure.calibration
Console backend: subscription service and API to return ranked tenants with pagination
Console frontend: ranked feed widget and per-tenant drilldown with top contributing signals
Create canary config to route exposure events for internal tenants only for first 2 weeks
Write runbook with triage steps and automatic links to deploys/PRs
updates: 2026-02-16: Kickoff meeting. Aligned on Beam + Dataflow. Agreed on initial feature weights (latency:0.5, error:0.3, cost:0.2) as starting point.

2026-02-24: Prototype computes exposure scores for internal tenant set using 30d sample. Observed high correlation between cost anomalies and traffic spikes for batch jobs; added route-level token-rate normalization.
2026-03-03: Implemented dedupe logic; reduced duplicate incidents in sample by ~55%. Slid smoothing windows to 5m/60m for responsiveness tradeoff.
2026-03-08: Console backend API stub merged (PR 902). Frontend mockups approved by PM and Design for the ranked feed card.
2026-03-12: Canary toggle ready. Will enable streaming to internal-tenants topic on Mon 2026-03-15 and collect feedback for 14 days. Assigned SRE for on-call shifts during canary: Priya Nair.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: False positives during large external events (cloud outage) -> Mitigation: cross-check region-level aggregation and lower severity if >80% of tenants affected
Risk: Increased cost for streaming compute -> Mitigation: use sampling for low-volume tenants and run heavier recalculation in backfill only
Risk: Schema churn -> Mitigation: version topic 'telemetry.slo_exposure.v1' and include job_version in payload
notes: We should consider adding a lightweight ML classifier in a follow-up to reduce alerts further once we have 60 days of labeled exposures
Discuss mapping of Escalation Tier -> PagerDuty routing with SRE and CSM teams before GA
Calibration workshop scheduled 2026-03-22 with CS, SRE, and PM to tune weights and thresholds
